title: should 2
subtitle: suggest/insist that… should, It's important that…, if… should

theory.text: После глаголов insist, demand, recommend, suggest, propose и выражений It's important / essential / vital / necessary that… можно поставить should: She insisted that I should stay. It's important that everyone should be on time.

head: Вариант
Пример
rows: The doctor recommended that I should walk more.
The doctor recommended that I walk more.
The doctor recommended that I walked more.

theory.text: После suggest не бывает конструкции «suggest somebody to do». Правильно: I suggest you read it., I suggested that she should buy it., Where do you suggest we go? или с -ing: He suggested meeting in a cafe.
should после strange, surprised, natural, typical
It's strange that she should say that. I was surprised that he should ask me. It's natural that you should feel nervous. Здесь should подчёркивает наше удивление или оценку.

items: If anyone should call, say I'm out. = если вдруг позвонят (вероятность небольшая).
Более официально — начать с Should: Should you need help, call us.
В британском английском I should… = совет «я бы на твоём месте…»: I should take a coat.

theory.text: Русское «Я предложил ему пойти» тянет сказать «I suggested him to go» — это ошибка. Говорите I suggested that he (should) go или I suggested going.
